meta.title: 33GOD Ship Board
meta.subtitle: Full system inventory → deployable component groups → dependency-ordered install plan. Target: Docker Compose per group, deploying to Damien's system.
meta.source: Ground truth sweep: 33GOD repo + submodules, docker ps (150 containers), 104 systemd user units, bloodbank services/compose, n8n, cron, skills

groups.name: G1 · Bloodbank Core Bus
groups.desc: The event backbone everything else publishes to. NATS + Dapr + schema registry + audit trail. Zero dependencies — install first.

components.name: bloodbank-nats
components.notes: NATS 2.10 + nats-init streams/subjects

components.name: bloodbank-dapr-placement
components.notes: Dapr 1.13 sidecar placement service

components.name: apicurio-registry
components.notes: CloudEvents schema registry

components.name: eventcatalog
components.notes: Event catalog UI

components.name: candystore + postgres + daprd
components.notes: Durable event audit trail (CloudEvents → PostgreSQL + query API + UI)

groups.name: G2 · Integration Plane (n8n + webhooks)
groups.desc: n8n is a prereq for dev-journal, HeyMa workflows, and the Plane→Bloodbank webhook. Runs as node binary today; wrap in container.

components.name: n8n (v2.18.4)
components.notes: Containerize; export workflows from integrations/n8n-workflows

components.name: n8n-nodes-bloodbank
components.notes: Custom node package — installs into n8n image

components.name: dev-journal workflows (ingress/processor/rollups/incidents/deadline)
components.notes: 6 workflow JSONs + build.mjs

components.name: folder-curator (curator-serve + curator-drain) + pdf2md-serve
components.notes: Bloodbank→n8n drain with backpressure; pdf2md HTTP converter

components.name: Plane → Bloodbank webhook
components.notes: Plane owns ticket facts; on Damien's: swap Plane for his tracker or ship Plane stack (plane-* ×9 containers)

groups.name: G3 · Agent Fleet Runtime
groups.desc: Hermes gateway + hook-hub + lifecycle services. The fleet that does the work.

components.name: hermes-gateway + hermes-dashboard
components.notes: Telegram/messaging ingress for the fleet; container image hermes-agent

components.name: hook-hub (bb-hook dispatcher)
components.notes: One dispatcher for every agent CLI's hooks; owns event publication

components.name: lifecycle-controller + heartbeat-tick + agent-hooks
components.notes: Task lifecycle + heartbeat cadence

components.name: bloodbank-ntfy-router
components.notes: Routes bus notifications to ntfy

components.name: ntfy + ntfy-upstream-gate
components.notes: Push notification transport

groups.name: G4 · Observability
groups.desc: The monitoring stack — self-contained compose in monitoring/ repo.

components.name: prometheus + grafana + loki + alloy + otel-collector
components.notes: Full compose exists; scrapes everything below

components.name: alertmanager + uptime-kuma + dockge + health-monitor

components.notes: aai-llm-observability tracks LLM spend (adapter: points at AAI gateway or any OpenAI-compatible)

groups.name: G5 · Project Tooling (PJangler + Skillex + CommonProject)
groups.desc: Operator-called-out dependency cluster: PJangler relies on Skillex (npm @delorenj/skillex) + CommonProject (copier template).

components.notes: npm package @delorenj/skillex 0.1.2 + ~/.agents/skills runtime dir

components.notes: pj CLI + pjangler-mcp + journal-notebook + project-registry services (compose services exist in 33god-platform)

components.name: mcp-hub
components.notes: MCP server hub (has Dockerfile)

groups.name: G6 · Voice Pipeline (HeyMa: Wax + Vinyl)
groups.desc: Operator example: 'install HeyMa → includes Wax and Vinyl + enrichment passes. n8n is a prereq. Bloodbank needed.'

components.name: Wax (recorder + pipeline engine + 11 passes)
components.notes: waxd systemd; passes.d: classification, diarization, frontmatter, wikification, title-slug, transcription-enhance, domain-curation, project-extraction, ticketable, mem-ops, clipboard-copy; pipelines: doc-standard, transcript-standard

components.name: Vinyl (dictation: vinyld + vinyld-serve + tray)
components.notes: sherpa-onnx parakeet recognizer; thin-client dictation server

components.name: transcription-service (workers 1+2)
components.notes: faster-whisper large-v3 + diarization (GPU); env -u PYTHONPATH quirk

components.name: HeyMa n8n workflows + n8n-nodes-heyma
components.notes: format-intake/format-completion + release.py

components.name: Audio intake: telnyx-s3-intake + syncthing-audio + remote-audio
components.notes: Pick transport per deployment (S3 bucket / syncthing / LAN)

components.name: Voxxy TTS (vox + voxxy-engine-voxcpm)
components.notes: Self-hosted TTS for spoken replies

groups.name: G7 · Enrichment + Memory (LLM-touching services)
groups.desc: Everything that calls an LLM. All repointed to OpenAI-compatible endpoints — for Damien's deployment these become config, not code.

components.notes: Bloodbank turn signal enrichment; JEV_URL → any endpoint

components.name: Hindsight memory + hindsight-litellm ladder + reranker
components.notes: vectorize 0.10.1 + TEI reranker + LiteLLM fallback ladder (provider-agnostic: point ladder at his endpoints)

components.name: AAI gateway + jev-litellm ingress
components.notes: Jarad's personal LLM front door — NOT shipped; Damien brings his own endpoint. Enrichers take any OpenAI-compatible base_url
